unit.why: Homiletic interpretations of verses from Bechukotai, Beha'alotkha and Shelach, including a witticism attributed to the Apta rabbi, plus a printer's note; no narrated events.
unit.boundary_note: opens mid-teaching (continuation of previous homily fragment 'א״י לרצונכם תזבחוהו'); ends with a printer's note deferring a sermon to part two
